apply_page.header_description: If you wish to join the WB Agency casting, please review the information below: fill out the application form and upload your photos for our digital evaluation.
apply_page.faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know before submitting your material.
apply_page.faq_measurements_q: What are the ideal measurements for the fashion and advertising industry?
apply_page.faq_measurements_a: There are no specific or fixed measurements. What matters most is having a striking personality, attitude, and a genuine passion to be a model.
apply_page.faq_height_a: In the fashion and advertising market, this varies greatly. We evaluate all profiles, regardless of height.
apply_page.faq_apply_steps_q: I want to be a model! How do I get a digital evaluation? What should my first steps be?
apply_page.faq_apply_steps_a: First, accurately fill out all your information and measurements in the form below, keep your Instagram and TikTok open for everyone to view, and include all photos. Regardless of the outcome, everyone will receive an email response. If the feedback is positive, we will guide you through the next steps.
apply_page.faq_photos_q: What should these photos look like? Do I need a professional book?
apply_page.faq_age_q: At what age can I work as a professional model?
apply_page.faq_age_a:
In the past it was common to see models starting at age 13 or 14, but the industry becomes more professional each year, which is why we do not represent children.

The Brazilian fashion market, in accordance with labor legislation, requires professional models to be at least 16 years old to work in any advertising campaign, photos, films, runway shows… In Brazil, emancipation is required for anyone aged 16 to 17 under labor court legislation.
apply_page.faq_fee_q: Do I need to pay any fee for an agency evaluation?
apply_page.faq_fee_a: No, simply submit your details, measurements, and photos, and wait for your digital evaluation feedback.
apply_page.faq_sp_q: Do I need to live in São Paulo?
apply_page.faq_sp_a: The main market clients are located in São Paulo – and the largest fashion week in Latin America takes place in the city. Therefore, being closer to this market is an advantage.
apply_page.faq_1_q: Is there any cost for application or evaluation?
apply_page.faq_1_a: No. WB Agency never charges any fees for applications, profile evaluations, video tests, or initial representation. Our scouting process is 100% free of charge. Beware of anyone asking for payments on our behalf.
apply_page.faq_2_q: What should the polaroids and photos look like?
apply_page.faq_2_a: Photos should be as natural as possible: shot in good daytime natural light, against a clean neutral background, with no heavy makeup, no social media filters, no sunglasses, and no hats or accessories covering your face. Basic neutral-colored clothing is recommended.
apply_page.faq_3_q: Can applicants under 18 years old apply?
apply_page.faq_3_a: Yes. WB Agency develops new talents starting from age 13. For applicants under 18 years old, parental/legal guardian consent and information (full name, tax ID/CPF, phone, and email) are strictly required.
apply_page.faq_4_q: How and when will I know the evaluation results?
apply_page.faq_4_a: Our casting directors review all submitted dossiers. Due to high submission volume, our team will get in touch within 5 business days if your profile fits our current commercial, fashion, or editorial agency demands.
apply_page.faq_5_q: What is the minimum height requirement to be a model?
apply_page.faq_5_a: For runway and international high fashion, industry standards typically start at 1.75m (5'9") for women and 1.83m (6'0") for men. However, for commercial casting, beauty, e-commerce, and advertising, requirements are flexible and we prioritize personality, charisma, and authentic presence above all.
apply_page.faq_6_q: Do I need previous modeling experience or school certification?
apply_page.faq_6_a: No previous experience or modeling course certification is required. WB Agency's scouting focuses on discovering raw, authentic talent and providing comprehensive career mentorship, runway training, and editorial direction.
apply_page.faq_7_q: Do I need a professional portfolio/book before applying?
apply_page.faq_7_a: No. Our casting directors prefer natural polaroids without styling or retouching. If selected, our management will guide and produce your official agency book and sedcard.
apply_page.faq_8_q: Can I apply if I live outside São Paulo or abroad?
apply_page.faq_8_a: Yes, we evaluate applicants from all Brazilian states and internationally. The preliminary screening is completely online. If approved, our team coordinates the logistics for test shoots and meetings based on your location.
apply_page.faq_9_a: WB Agency maintains strategic partnerships with top fashion agencies across Paris, Milan, New York, and London. We manage international placement through transparent contracts, prioritizing talent protection and long-term career growth.
